headline: Mikel Arteta exclusive interview: ‘I have poison in my veins at Champions League defeat. It left a scar’
body: "I made a commitment with myself. I need to enjoy the journey and I’m going to live the journey. Because I didn’t know how tough it was going to be, I had no experience, I never did it before. I have to be so alert, so curious, and just go day by day.” Mikel Arteta has transformed Arsenal since taking charge in 2019. After a Premier League title win and a new four-year deal, Amy Lawrence sat down with the Spaniard for an exclusive interview to discuss the cultural revolution he started, why he planted an 140-year-old olive tree and how this is 'just the beginning'.   submitted by   /u/TheAthletic [link]   [comments]
